slug: 2025-12-29 Chad Steps Up Rollout of Tchad Connexion 2030 in Talks With Huawei

facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa, 29 December 2025, reports that on 24 December 2025 the Minister of the Digital Economy and Digitalisation, Boukar Michel, held talks with a Huawei North Africa delegation on expanding telecoms infrastructure and digitalising public administration, and that both sides explored turning the talks into concrete projects aligned with 'Tchad Connexion 2030'; no contract or funding is stated.

systems.country_label: Tchad Connexion 2030 (called 'national digital strategy' and 'digital transformation strategy')
systems.tiers: national, as the article calls it; aims to expand connectivity and modernise public services; pillars not described

note: Scope is described only as connectivity and public services, so class is left empty. No adoption verb, act, period or cost is stated, so no other aspect.
